proposals.title: CVE-2026-59191: TwigView FileLoader may allow arbitrary file reads through user-controlled template paths
proposals.author: GitHub Advisory
proposals.summary: ### Impact If `FileLoader::findTemplate()` is supplied un-validated user controlled data, arbitrary files can be read. ### Patches 1.3.3 and 2.1.2 contain a fix for this issue. ### Workarounds Don't supply user controlled data to `include` and `extends` tags.

proposals.title: CVE-2026-59192: Cakephp twig-view unserialize Twig filter allows arbitrary object deserialization
proposals.author: GitHub Advisory
proposals.summary: ### Impact The `unserialize` filter has no restriction on which classes are allowed. This can be used as a deserialization remote-code-execution gadget. ### Patches 1.3.3 and 2.1.2 contain a fix for this issue. The fix may impact backwards compatibility if you are relying on deserializing PHP objects in your templates. ### Workarounds Don't use the `unserialize` filter.
